title: The day-one record keeps getting crushed #gta6 #shorts
description: Black Ops II $500M (FOX 5), GTA V ~$815M, GTA VI $3.79B preorders + first day (Take-Two).

scenes.say: Watch the day one record get destroyed again and again.

scenes.title: Day-one record holders
scenes.say: Black Ops 2 held it with five hundred million. GTA 5 beat it with about eight hundred fifteen million. Then GTA 6 hit three point seven nine billion.
That GTA 6 number includes preorders, according to Take-Two.
Will any game ever beat this?
